english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the main point or focus receiving special attention.
This is the everyday all-purpose noun for the main thing receiving attention or effort.
Use this for an important point, item, or thing singled out from others.
Use 重點 for the central idea or the particularly important detail rather than a merely mentioned point.
Use this for the main emphasis, priority, or focus, as in putting the emphasis on luxury.
Use this for the main idea or point that someone should remember from a talk or presentation.
Use this for the point or aspect that someone deliberately emphasizes in an argument or discussion.
Use this for the important substance or key point of a document, discussion, or project.
